mapper.sql: select category_id, category_name, order_num, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from prop_repair_category
mapper.select: and category_name like concat('%', #{categoryName}, '%')and status = #{status} order by order_num asc, category_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into prop_repair_category(category_name, order_num, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{categoryName}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update prop_repair_category category_name = #{categoryName},order_num = #{orderNum},status = #{status},remark = #{remark},update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.delete: delete from prop_repair_category where category_id in #{id}
